scene:
The picture has three areas side by side, read left to right, with no titles or headings above them.

On the left third: a single row of exactly ten equal square day-tiles, all the same size, like a ten-day calendar strip, grouped into three groups with small gaps between groups (7 + 2 + 1 = 10 tiles in total): SEVEN ochre tiles (count them: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 — the ochre group is clearly the longest, much longer than the teal group), each with a tiny hourglass, with a bracket beneath labelled QUEUE 7 DAYS; then two teal tiles, each with a tiny wrench, with a bracket beneath labelled BUILD 2; then one pale tile with a tiny rocket, labelled RELEASE 1 beneath it. From above, a robotic hand with a chip on its wrist reaches down and touches ONLY the two teal tiles; the hand is labelled AI TOOL. Beneath the whole row, one ochre ribbon labelled SAVES 1 DAY IN 10.

In the centre third: a balance scale. On the heavy, lower pan sits a stack of finished items (a small gear and a check-marked box), labelled COMPLETED WORK; attached to the scale's post is a small steady gauge with its needle on the middle line, labelled ERROR RATE HOLDS. Beside the scale, on the floor, a grey waste bin into which a cursor arrow, a key-card seat pass and a few small plain blank discs with no symbols on them are dropped, labelled NOT CAPACITY: LINES, SEATS, TOKENS.

On the right third: a large gate with a small calendar tag on it labelled GATE: DAY 120. From the gate three paths branch to the right, each ending in a signpost-like marker with its label: an upper path ending at a ochre octagonal stop sign labelled WITHDRAW; a middle path ending at an hourglass labelled ONE EXTENSION; a lower path ending at a teal check mark next to a stopwatch labelled CONTINUE IF REVIEW FUNDED. Below the gate, separate from the paths, a card with exactly five small person outlines and a padlock, labelled SECOND TEAM: UNCHANGED.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: QUEUE 7 DAYS, BUILD 2, RELEASE 1, AI TOOL, SAVES 1 DAY IN 10, COMPLETED WORK, ERROR RATE HOLDS, NOT CAPACITY: LINES, SEATS, TOKENS, GATE: DAY 120, WITHDRAW, ONE EXTENSION, CONTINUE IF REVIEW FUNDED, SECOND TEAM: UNCHANGED. The day-tiles carry no numbers; the calendar tag, card, gauge and signs carry no other writing. No currency symbols. Never write the words LEFT, CENTRE, RIGHT, ZONE or any heading. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A ten-day trace of a pricing change shows seven queue days, two building days and one release day, with an AI tool touching only the building days and saving one day in ten; a scale weighs completed work, with a steady error-rate gauge, against lighter lines, seats and tokens, which are not capacity; a gate on day 120 leads to withdraw, one extension, or continue if review is funded, while a locked card shows the second team unchanged.
caption: Attach the claim to a stage, count completed work, and decide at a gate that leaves the second team's conditions unchanged.
